en.hero_sub: ExecutorBTC is a trend-following system built to capture major moves while keeping losses small. Every chart, trade and analysis below is based on real historical data - verify it yourself.

en.an_sub: Shows the average, worst and best returns you would have seen if you had started using the bot for different holding periods within the selected range. It accounts for every possible entry moment - not one lucky timing.
en.an_note: The “worst” column is the return of the worst possible timing for that window length. For windows of 1 year and longer it has historically always been positive.
en.an_explain_b1: A fixed-length window (e.g. 1 year) is slid across the entire history day by day, and the return of that period is computed for every starting point.
en.an_explain_b2: Then the worst, average and best of those returns are reported. So you see the range of outcomes you could face whenever you start - not one lucky timing.

strategy.b: ExecutorBTC is a trend-following bot trading BTC. It aims to capture major market moves while keeping losses small. Trade frequency is low and some positions stay open for a long time, so maker/taker commissions and funding fees have stayed under ~5% per year in long-term live usage.
The system only trades BTC/USDT futures and typically uses 2x leverage. Backtests assume 100% capital usage; live usage typically uses ~85% capital to leave an extra safety margin.
Entries and exits follow fixed rules; there is no emotional or manual intervention. The system makes the same decision every time it sees the same market conditions.
No strategy is risk-free. Short-term drawdowns can happen; past performance does not guarantee future results. Only trade with capital you can afford to risk.

strategy.b: ExecutorBTC, BTC üzerinde çalışan bir trend-takip botudur. Büyük piyasa hareketlerini yakalamayı hedeflerken kayıpları küçük tutar. İşlem sıklığı düşüktür ve bazı pozisyonlar uzun süre açık kalır; bu sayede maker/taker komisyonları ve funding ücretlerinin toplam etkisi uzun vadeli canlı kullanımda yıllık ~%5'in altında kalmıştır.
Sistem sadece BTC/USDT futures işlemi yapar ve genellikle 2x kaldıraç kullanır. Backtestler %100 sermaye kullanımını varsayar; canlıda ek güvenlik payı için genellikle ~%85 sermaye kullanılır.
Girişler ve çıkışlar sabit kurallarla verilir; duygusal ya da elle müdahale yok. Sistem aynı piyasa koşulunda her zaman aynı kararı verir.
Hiçbir strateji risksiz değildir. Kısa vadede düşüşler olabilir; geçmiş performans geleceği garanti etmez. Yalnızca risk alabileceğiniz sermaye ile işlem yapın.

strategy.b: ExecutorBTC بوت لتتبّع الاتجاه يتداول BTC. يهدف إلى التقاط تحركات السوق الكبيرة مع إبقاء الخسائر صغيرة. وتيرة التداول منخفضة وتبقى بعض المراكز مفتوحة لفترة طويلة، لذلك بقي الأثر الإجمالي لعمولات الصانع/الآخذ ورسوم التمويل دون ~5% سنويًا في الاستخدام المباشر طويل الأمد.
يتداول النظام عقود BTC/USDT الآجلة فقط ويستخدم عادةً رافعة 2x. تفترض الاختبارات الرجعية استخدام 100% من رأس المال؛ أما الاستخدام المباشر فيستخدم عادةً نحو 85% لترك هامش أمان إضافي.
تتم عمليات الدخول والخروج وفق قواعد ثابتة، دون أي تدخل عاطفي أو يدوي. يتخذ النظام القرار نفسه في كل مرة يواجه فيها ظروف السوق نفسها.
لا توجد استراتيجية خالية من المخاطر. قد تحدث تراجعات قصيرة الأجل؛ والأداء السابق لا يضمن النتائج المستقبلية. تداول فقط برأس مال يمكنك تحمّل المخاطرة به.
